decision.proposal: Adopt the canonical JSON profile recommended in the attached WI-02 design investigation: a typed, versioned envelope identifying the contract, canonical profile, record kind, schema version and body; UTF-8 with deterministic key ordering, preserved array order and Unicode content, and a specified escaping convention; absent optional fields omitted and null rejected unless permitted; bounded integers and schema-defined decimal strings; UTC timestamps with nine fractional digits; rejection of duplicate keys, unknown fields, unsupported versions and invalid representations before hashing. Use domain-separated SHA-256 over canonical envelopes excluding their own derived digest/identity and signatures, and hash artifact contents as exact bytes. Specify exact hash inputs and golden bytes/digests for idempotency, authorization binding and receipts. Routine encoding details within this profile must be documented and fixture-tested during implementation. Detailed effect lifecycle semantics remain ADR-007 and final receipt/signing decisions remain ADR-008. This decision does not claim implementation or verification completion.
decision.sourceReferences: wi-fabric-2-foundational-implementation-plan.md §§2.2–2.5, §4 ADR allocation, WI-02 and §8; attached WI-02 investigation, Recommended ADR resolutions → ADR-001.

approval.rationale: I, as operator agree with the recommendation and approve this decision.
